title: haex-hive Install Lockfile v3
description: Schema for `.haex-hive/install.lock` under v3 vocabulary. Renames v2 `atoms[]` to `molecules[]` and `atomInstallRecord` to `moleculeInstallRecord`. Semantics inherit from Spec 008.

constitution.description: Constitution block. Present when the install includes at least one molecule contributing a constitution.

molecules.description: One entry per adopted molecule whose contribution is recorded in this install. Renamed from v2 `atoms[]`.

generation_inputs.description: Immutable adapter and tool-configuration identities used to generate this publication; order MUST be `(kind, id)`-sorted.

participating_roots.description: MUST match `visibility.json.participating_roots` byte-identically at publication time.

visibility_marker.description: Cross-reference to the `.haex-hive/visibility.json` marker this lock corresponds to (by `generation_id` only).

rootName.description: Repo-relative directory with trailing slash, e.g. '.haex-hive/'.

contributed_paths.description: Unique POSIX repo-relative paths written by this molecule under participating roots. Each path must start with a participating root name (as listed in `participating_roots`); this semantic relationship is enforced by the tool at load time, since JSON Schema alone cannot express it.

repoRelativePath.description: Repository-relative POSIX path: no leading/trailing slash, no control characters, no empty, `.`, or `..` segments, no backslashes.
